highlights.text: “We have the need.” “But you don’t have the right!” Zachary nodded. “Yes, that may be. But we had to come, and we had to ask, and now we have to hear the answer.”

No, I don’t believe in that kind of Hell. Not at the center of the world, not with devils carrying pitchforks. But Hell is right here on earth, John, and people can step into it without knowing, and they can’t get out—”
“Don’t you understand that I try to do my best?” she asked softly, her voice quavering. “That’s all there is in this world: to try to do the best you can.…”
